Lochia.6: Pashure pokubereka, lochia inoreva kubuda kwepamuviri kunobatanidzwa nenzira yechisikigo yokudzorera muchibereko. Ruvara rwacho uye uwandu hwacho zvinoshanduka zvishoma nezvishoma mumazuva nevhiki zvinotevera.
Lochia.12: Ndirini pandinofanira kutsvaka mazano kuna chiremba?
Lochia.15: Lochia inonzi vaginal discharge iyo inoitika pashure pokubereka. Inonyanya kuita kuti ropa, zvirimwa, uye tishu zvibve muchibereko zvadzoka.
Lochia.16: Kusiyana nenguva dzose, kunotarisirwa munguva yapashure pokuberekwa uye kazhinji kunoderedza zvishoma nezvishoma.
Lochia.18: Lochia hairevi kuti nguva yako yakadzoka, asi kuti nguva yako inodzoka.
Lochia.20: Chitarisiko chayo chinowanzochinja mumavhiki mashomanana okutanga.
Lochia.25: Kubuda kwomvura kunowanzova kutsvuku uye kunogona kuva kwakanyanya pakutanga.
Lochia.28: Ruvara rwunowedzera kupenya zvishoma nezvishoma uye runogona kuchinja ruchienda kune ruvara rwepepuru kana ruvara rwebhuruu.
Lochia.31: Kunobuda kunowanzosvibiswa, kuchena kana kuti kuchena, kusati kwapera.
Lochia.33: Nzira iyo lochia inoshanduka nayo haisiyo yakafanana kune vose.
Lochia.35: Mari yacho inogona kuchinja mumazuva mashomanana okutanga uye inoderedza zvishoma nezvishoma.
Lochia.37: Lochia inowanzosvika pakuva yakajeka nokufamba kwenguva.
Lochia.39: Rinogona kupfuurira kwemavhiki akati kuti, uye nzira iyo rinokura nayo inosiyana kubva kumunhu mumwe nomumwe.
Lochia.41: Munguva iyi, kuongorora zviri nyore kunogona kukubatsira kuona kuti muviri wako uri kuchinja sei usingambofananidzi zvawakaona nevamwe.
Lochia.43: Farira kugeza zvinyoro-nyoro, nguva dzose pasina zvinogumbura.
Lochia.45: Unogona kuona ruvara, uwandu, uye kufambira mberi kwechido chacho kana izvozvo zvichikubatsira kuti uone kuti uri kupora sei.
Lochia.47: Nguva yokusununguka inotora nguva, teerera muviri wako uye ramba uchiremekedza chido chako chokupora.
Lochia.48: 5. Lochia kana kuti kudzoka kwemwedzi wako?
Lochia.49: Lochia inooneka mumazuva anotevera kuberekwa uye inoderedza zvishoma nezvishoma.
Lochia.51: Kubuda kunobatanidzwa nekudzoka kwechibereko pashure pokuberekwa.
Lochia.53: Kuenderera mberi kwemwedzi, panguva inosiyana-siyana pakati pemunhu nomumwe.
Lochia.55: Kana kufambira mberi kwacho kuchiita sokusingawanzoitiki kwauri, kana kuti kana mamiriro ako ose achiwedzera kuipa, zvinokosha kuti ubvunze chiremba.
Lochia.58: Kuneta kana kuti mamiriro ezvinhu akaipa
Lochia.60: Kurwadziwa kwakakura, kunoramba kuripo, kana kuti kusingawanzoitiki
Lochia.63: Lochia inowanzova zvishoma nezvishoma: inogona kuva tsvuku pakutanga, uye inobva yava kupenya isati yaora.
Lochia.65: Lochia inonzi inowanzobuda mwana paanenge aberekwa.
Lochia.66: Kazhinji ruvara rwacho uye uwandu hwacho zvinochinja mumavhiki.
Lochia.67: Nguva yainoita uye kuti inoenderera mberi sei inogona kusiyana-siyana.
Lochia.68: Kunhuwa kusingawanzoitiki, fivha, kurwadziwa kukuru, kana kuti kubuda ropa kamwe kamwe, kwakanyanya kunoda kubvunzwa nachiremba.
Lochia.69: Mashoko ari munyaya ino haatsivi mazano ekurapa kana kuti kuongororwa. Kana uine mubvunzo kana kuti ukaona chiratidzo chinokutambudza, bvunza nyanzvi yeutano.

MedicalExams.6: Ultrasounds uye kuongorora kunokosha, trimester ne trimester.
MedicalExams.13: Pamuviri panenge paine ma ultrasound matatu makuru, rimwe chete pamwedzi mumwe nomumwe, rimwe nerimwe riine chinangwa chakasiyana.
MedicalExams.17: Kuongororwa kweropa nguva dzose kunotarisa zvinhu zvinokosha zvinoratidza kuti uri pamuviri:
MedicalExams.18: Zvikamu zvesimbi, kuti zviongororwe kana paine kushaya ropa
MedicalExams.19: Kuongororwa kwechirwere cheshuga chepamuviri, kazhinji kumativi e2 trimester
MedicalExams.21: Kuongororwa kwe serology (toxoplasmosis, rubella) zvichienderana nemamiriro ako ezvirwere
MedicalExams.22: Nyora mibvunzo yako sezvainouya kwauri, usati waikanganwa
MedicalExams.23: Uyai nemabhuku enyu ekuongorora pamuviri pamusangano mumwe nomumwe
MedicalExams.24: Taura nezvechiratidzo chipi nechipi chitsva, kunyange kana chichiratidzika kuva chiduku
MedicalExams.25: Nhamba chaiyo yezvirongwa uye purogiramu yezvirongwa zvinogona kusiyana zvichienderana nokuchengetwa kwako, njodzi yako, uye tsika dzenyika yako kana kuti dzomupi wezvokurapwa.
MedicalExams.27: Usazeza kunyora mibvunzo yako pamberi peboka rimwe nerimwe kuitira kuti usakanganwa chinhu panguva yacho: hapana mubvunzo uri muduku zvikuru kuti ubvunze.

MenopauseHormones.6: Sezvo nguva yekare inenge yava pedyo, mahormone ako haamiri kamwe kamwe: anoderera, izvo zvinotsanangura kuchinja kwemutambo uye zvakasiyana-siyana zviratidzo zvinogona kuitika.
MenopauseHormones.17: Nzira yokucherechedza nayo zviri nani kuchinja
MenopauseHormones.21: Mahomoni makuru matatu anochinja panguva iyi, rimwe nerimwe riine basa rakasiyana:
MenopauseHormones.23: Inokanganisa kutenderera, ganda, mapfupa, mwoyo, uye zvimwe zvinodzora kurara uye mafungiro.
MenopauseHormones.25: Inogadzirwa pashure pokunge ovulation yapera, ine simba rinonyaradza uye rinogadzirira muviri kuti ugone kuva nepamuviri.
MenopauseHormones.27: Dzinodzorwa neuropi, dzinokurudzira mazai; mazinga adzo anochinja sezvo mazai anopindura zvakasiyana.
MenopauseHormones.29: Huwandu hwehomoni hahudereri nenzira yakakwana panguva yeperi-menopause: hunogona kuchinja, kukwira uye kuderera, usati wagara pasi pamwero wakaderera pashure pemamenopause.
MenopauseHormones.30: Mazai anowedzera kupindura zvishoma nezvishoma kumashumo ehormone anotumirwa neuropi. Izvi zvinoita kuti kutenderera kusarongeka uye zvinotsanangura kuti nei zviratidzo zvingashanduka mwedzi nemwedzi.
MenopauseHormones.32: Zvinogona kuitika kuti munhu ave nezviratidzo zvinooneka mwedzi mumwe chete, uye anenge asina zviratidzo zvinotevera.
MenopauseHormones.33: Kuchinja kweestrogen kunogona kuenderana nekuchinja kwakati:
MenopauseHormones.40: Zviratidzo izvi zvinogona kuva nezvikonzero zvinoverengeka: hazvibatanidzwi nguva dzose nehormone, uye kusimba kwazvo kunosiyana zvikuru kubva kumunhu mumwe nomumwe.
MenopauseHormones.41: Progesterone inogadzirwa chete mushure mekuberekwa kwemapfupa. Asi panguva yeperimenopause, ovulation pachayo inova isina kurongeka  ⁇  izvo zvinoita kuti kugadzirwa kwayo kusatarisirwe.
MenopauseHormones.42: Kusarongeka uku kunotsanangurawo kuchinja kunoitika mumutambo: kureba kunochinja, nguva dzimwe nguva dzakarema kana kuti dzakareruka kupfuura kare.
MenopauseHormones.43: Kunze kwokushanduka kwehomoni, pane zvimwe zvinhu zvinobatanidzwa: kunaka kwekurara, kuora mwoyo, mararamiro, uye kusiyana kwevanhu.
MenopauseHormones.44: "Mukadzi mumwe nomumwe anoona kuchinja nenzira yakasiyana".
MenopauseHormones.54: Urongwa uhwu ndehwokuziva chete: hausi chirwere. Munhu mumwe nomumwe anoona kusanganiswa kwakasiyana kwemishanduko iyi.
MenopauseHormones.55: Kuita kuti munhu arare usiku kunogona kuita kuti munhu atadze kurara, zvoita kuti munhu anetseke uye atadze kuramba achitsvaka zvokuita zuva rinotevera.
MenopauseHormones.57: Imba yokurara inotonhorera, mbatya dzakareruka, uye kurara nguva dzose zvinogona kubatsira kudzikamisa kumuka uku.
MenopauseHormones.58: Kuchinja kwemahomoni kunogona kuitika pamwe chete nokuchinja kwemanzwiro, asi hakusi iko chete kunotsanangura: kurara, kushushikana, kuchinja kweupenyu, uye zviratidzo zvomuviri zvinoitawo basa.
MenopauseHormones.60: Kunzwa kuti pane zvakawanda zvinokonzera manzwiro panguva ino hakurevi kuti pane chimwe chinhu chisina kunaka: chiitiko chakajairika chinogona kuva nezvikonzero zvakawanda panguva imwe chete.
MenopauseHormones.61: Huwandu hwehomoni hunogona kusiyana zvikuru kubva pazuva rimwe nerimwe panguva yeperimenopause.
MenopauseHormones.63: Kuongororwa kwaunoitwa nechiremba kunonyanya kubva pazera rako, zviratidzo zvako, uye nhoroondo yako yemitambo  ⁇  kwete nhamba imwe chete.
MenopauseHormones.64: Kunyora zvaunoona mwedzi nemwedzi kunokubatsira kuona zvaunoita pachako pane kuzvienzanisa nevamwe:
MenopauseHormones.71: Chii chinoita sokuti chinokonzera zvimwe zviratidzo
MenopauseHormones.73: Kuongorora nguva yako muAWA kunogona kukubatsira kuona maitiro ako mumwedzi, pasina kuedza kwakawedzerwa.
MenopauseHormones.74: Mamiriro ezvinhu akawanda aya anoda kuti munhu afumbirane nguva dzose, panguva yaunofanira kuita zvaunoda:
MenopauseHormones.76: Zviratidzo zvinokanganisa upenyu hwako hwezuva nezuva
MenopauseHormones.82: Kunetseka pamusoro pokuoma kwomukadzi kana kuti upenyu hwako hwepabonde
MenopauseHormones.84: Asi ropa rakanyanya kana kuti risingawanzoitiki rinofanira kuudzwa chiremba nokukurumidza.
MenopauseHormones.85: Zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu, nyanzvi inogona kupa mazano akasiyana-siyana:
MenopauseHormones.87: Kuita basa, kudya, uye kurara zvakanaka.
MenopauseHormones.89: Dzimwe nzira dzingashandiswa pakurwisa zviratidzo zvakasiyana-siyana zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu.
MenopauseHormones.92: Zvisarudzo izvi zvinoramba zviri zvemunhu oga: zvinoenderana nezvakaitika kwauri, zviratidzo zvako, njodzi, uye zvaunofarira.
MenopauseHormones.93: Kuchinja kwehomoni kunokosha zvikuru pakushanduka kwemwedzi.
MenopauseHormones.94: Huwandu hwehomoni hunogona kuchinja zvikuru panguva yeperimenopause, pasina kuderera kwakakwana.
MenopauseHormones.95: Zviratidzo zvinosiyana zvikuru kubva kumunhu mumwe nomumwe, uye mwedzi nomwedzi.
MenopauseHormones.96: Kuongorora zviratidzo zvako kunogona kukubatsira kuti uzive zviri nani maitiro ako.
MenopauseHormones.97: Chiremba anogona kukubatsira kana zviratidzo zvacho zvikaoma kubata nazvo.
MenopauseHormones.98: Nyaya ino haitsivi mazano evanhu panyaya dzeutano.

MenopauseTransition.6: Chii chinoshanduka zvishoma nezvishoma, makore asati apera nguva, uye nzira yokushanyira nayo danho iri zvakajeka.
MenopauseTransition.13: Ngano Dzakajairika Pamusoro Pekuenda Kunopera Kwemakore
MenopauseTransition.18: Perimenopause inoreva nguva yokushanduka kwemahomoni inotangira kumwedzi: inogona kutanga makore akati wandei pamberi pechirwere chacho, kazhinji kubva pamakore ako okuma40 zvichienda mberi, uye mazinga eestrogen anochinja-chinja zvisina kururama.
MenopauseTransition.19: Kufamba kwenguva, kunenge kwava kunokosha chaizvo: kunosimbiswa pashure pemwedzi 12 yenguva, pasina chikonzero, uye pasina chimwe chikonzero.
MenopauseTransition.21: Mudzimai mumwe nomumwe anoona kuchinja uku nenzira yakasiyana, zvose maererano nenguva yaanoita uye kuwanda kwezviratidzo.
MenopauseTransition.23: Chimwe chezviratidzo zvokutanga zveperi-menopause kazhinji kazhinji kuchinja kwokuramba uchitenderera: kutenderera kunogona kupfupika, kureba, kuva nemiganhu yakawanda, kana kuti kuva nemugumisiro wakasiyana kubva pamwedzi mumwe kusvika kune mumwe.
MenopauseTransition.25: Kubuda ropa kwakanyanya, kubuda ropa kunongoitika pedyo zvikuru, kana kuti kubuda ropa kunongoitika pashure pegore pasina nguva kunoda kurairwa nachiremba, sezvo izvi zvisiri zviratidzo zvenguva yokushanduka.
MenopauseTransition.27: Kuderera uye kuchinja kweestrogen uye progesterone kunogona kukanganisa hope (kuvata, kumuka usiku) uye kunogona kuperekedzwa nokutsamwa, kuzvidya mwoyo, kana kuti kuchinja kwemanzwiro.
MenopauseTransition.28: Kuchinja uku kune tsanangudzo chaiyo yezvokudya: hakuratidzi kushayikwa kwesimba rokuda kana kuti dambudziko repfungwa rakaparadzaniswa.
MenopauseTransition.30: Kuderera kweestrogen kunogona kuita kuti nhumbu dzomuchato dzomiswe, dzimwe nguva zvichikonzera kusagadzikana kana kuti kurwadziwa paunenge uchiita zvepabonde.
MenopauseTransition.32: Pane mhinduro dzakareruka (mafuta, zvinonwisa mvura zvomuviri, kurapwa kwomunharaunda): kutaura nenyanzvi yezvokurapa kunogona kukubatsira kuwana mhinduro yakarurama, pasina chinonzi chakaipa.
MenopauseTransition.34: Kuchinja kwemagetsi kunogona kunonoka zvishoma panguva iyi, uye kuwanda kwemafuta kunowanzochinja kunotangira mudumbu.
MenopauseTransition.36: Kubuda mumimba "kunoitika kamwe chete"  ⁇  chaizvoizvo, kunotangira nemakore akawanda okuchinja (perimenopause)
MenopauseTransition.37: Zviratidzo zvose zvinorwadza munhu wose  ⁇  simba razvo rinosiyana zvikuru kubva kumukadzi kuenda kumukadzi
MenopauseTransition.38: Hapana chingaitwa  ⁇  mhinduro dzakawanda, dzegormone kana kuti kwete, dziripo kuti dzinyorese zviratidzo zvinonetsa
MenopauseTransition.39: Upenyu hwepedyo hunoguma  ⁇  hunochinja, asi hunoramba huchikwanisika uye hunogutsa nekuchinja kwakakodzera
MenopauseTransition.41: Kuwanda kwezvinhu zvinenge zvachinja pano kunoratidza kuti munhu ari kuchinja asi pane zvimwe zvinoratidza kuti anofanira kurapwa.
MenopauseTransition.43: Kubuda ropa pashure pokunge nguva yokuchenesa yaitika, kurwadziwa kusingawanzoitiki kwepeltvic, zviratidzo zvinokanganisa upenyu hwezuva nezuva, kana kuti kusava nechokwadi chero kupi zvako.
MenopauseTransition.46: Kuita basa rokurovedza muviri nguva dzose
MenopauseTransition.51: Perimenopause uye menopause zviitiko zvakasikwa, kwete chirwere. Kune nzira dzakawanda dzokubatsira kupfuura nenzira iyi zviri nyore: nyanzvi yezvokurapa inoramba iri chinhu chakanakisisa chokuzvigadzirisa nemamiriro ako ezvinhu.

MenopauseTreatments.6: Kurapa kunotsiva mahormone uye dzimwe nzira dzisina mahormone, kuti zvikubatsire kugadzirira kukurukura nachiremba wako.
MenopauseTreatments.8: Chirwere chekutsiva hormone chemurume anoenda kumwedzi
MenopauseTreatments.13: Chirwere chekuti munhu apinde mumatambudziko okuderera kwemimba chinobatsira kuti estrogen isanyanya kuwanda uye chinogona kubvisa zviratidzo zvinonetsa zvakadai sekupisa, kurara zvisina kunaka, kana kuti kuoma kwemapfupa.
MenopauseTreatments.14: HRT inogonawo kubatsira kudzivirira kuwanda kwemapfupa. zvisinei, haisi yakakodzera mamiriro ose: nhoroondo yevanhu yeimwe mamiriro ezvinhu (chirwere chemwoyo, dzimwe homoni-inotsamira kenza) inogona kudzikisira kushandiswa kwayo.
MenopauseTreatments.16: Kubatsirana kwenhamo nenjodzi yeHRT kunobva pazera rako, paunotanga kurapwa uchienzanisa nemamenopause, uye nhoroondo yako yezvokurapa: kuongororwa kwezvokurapa kunofanira kuitwa munhu mumwe nomumwe asati aita chisarudzo.
MenopauseTreatments.17: Kana HRT isingadiwi kana kuti isingadiwi, pane dzimwe nzira dzokubatsira kubvisa zviratidzo:
MenopauseTreatments.18: Cognitive behavioral therapy (yekugadzirisa kushushikana uye kurara)
MenopauseTreatments.19: Mishonga yemishonga yemakwenzi, inotarisirwa nenyanzvi yezvokurapa
MenopauseTreatments.21: Mafuta anodhaka uye anoisa mvura mumukadzi kuti ave akaoma
MenopauseTreatments.23: Kunyange mishonga yemishonga inoda mazano ehunyanzvi:  ⁇ natural ⁇  hairevi  ⁇ kusagona kudyidzana ⁇  nemamwe marapirwo.
MenopauseTreatments.24: Kugadzirira pfungwa shomanana musati mapinda musangano kunokubatsira kuti uwedzere kukurukura:
MenopauseTreatments.25: Zviratidzo zvako zvinonetsa zvikuru zvezuva nezuva
MenopauseTreatments.27: Zvaunofarira (zvine mahormone kana kuti kwete, uri kufunga kwenguva yakareba sei)
MenopauseTreatments.28: Mibvunzo yako uye zvinokunetsa  ⁇   ⁇  usazeza kuibvunza
MenopauseTreatments.30: Hormonal kana kwete, hapana kurapwa kwese kwese: kuti chii chakakunakira kunobva pane zvauri kuita, zvichiongororwa nenyanzvi yezvokurapa.

MenstruationPurity.6: Kunzwisisa ukama huripo pakati pedzimwe nguva uye tsika dzokuchena, kuswedera pedyo nenguva ino zvakajeka.
MenstruationPurity.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
MenstruationPurity.16: Mukutonga kwechiIslam, kuchena kwetsika (tahara) kunoreva mamiriro anodiwa kuita zvimwe zviito zvekunamata, sekunamata. Hairevi kuchena mupfungwa yezuva nezuva, asi kune imwe mamiriro anozivikanwa nefiqh, ayo anochinja zvinoenderana nezvikamu zvemuviri wechikadzi.
MenstruationPurity.17: Panguva yokusununguka, mukadzi anopiwa mvumo yokuita zvimwe zvinhu zvokunamata, kunyanya munyengetero uye kutsanya kweRamadan, izvo zvinogona kuitwa gare gare.
MenstruationPurity.18: Zvinhu zvinoramba zviripo panguva yokushaya ropa
MenstruationPurity.20: Kuteerera kana kuverenga zvinhu zvinodzidzisa uye zvine chokuita nokunamata
MenstruationPurity.21: Kutsigira tsika dzechitendero dzevaya vari pedyo newe
MenstruationPurity.24: Mamwe mashoko (akadai sokuverenga Korani zvakananga kana kupinda mumusoja) anogona kusiyana zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo; zvakanakisisa kutaura nezvemaonero aunowanzotevera kana kuti nyanzvi ine unyanzvi panyaya idzi.
MenstruationPurity.25: Kupera kwomwedzi kunoratidza kudzokera zvishoma nezvishoma kunzvimbo yokuchena kwetsika. Munyama, izvi zvinoenderana nokumiswa kweropa, chiratidzo icho tsika dzakasiyana-siyana dzedzidzo dzinogona kutsanangura nemamwe mativi akasiyana-siyana.
MenstruationPurity.27: Kunzwisisa nhanho dzomutambo kunokubatsira kuziva nguva chaiyo yokupedzisira kwemwedzi.
MenstruationPurity.28: Kana chiratidzo ichi chaonekwa, ghusl (kugezwa kukuru) kunobvumira munhu kudzokera kuutsvene hwetsika ndokutangazve mabasa okunamata akanga amiswa.
MenstruationPurity.29: Ghusl inzira huru yekugeza iyo inosanganisira kugeza muviri wose nechinangwa chekuzvichenesa. Inoratidza kupera kwekusunungurwa uye inobvumira munamato kuti utangezve zvakajairika, pasina kudiwa kwekuita minamato yakarasika panguva yekushanda.
MenstruationPurity.31: Nzira chaiyo yeGhusl inogona kusiyana zvishoma zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo chakatorwa.
MenstruationPurity.33: Kana usingazivi matanho chaiwo anotevera kuchikoro chako, mumwe munhu waunovimba naye kana kuti nyanzvi ine unyanzvi achakwanisa kukutsanangurira zvakajeka.
MenstruationPurity.34: Zvakajairika kunzwa kusava nechokwadi pamusoro pokuti nguva yokusununguka yakaguma rini chaizvoizvo, zvikurukuru apo kubuda ropa kunoderera zvishoma nezvishoma panzvimbo pokuti kumira kamwe kamwe.
MenstruationPurity.36: Ona kushayikwa kworopa zvachose, kwete kungodzikira
MenstruationPurity.37: Rega nguva yakakwana ipfuure usati wapedza kugara pamwedzi
MenstruationPurity.39: Ona kuti unogara uchiramba uchiridza sei, uye unogona kusiyana-siyana sei
MenstruationPurity.41: Kana uchiramba uchiropa kwenguva refu kana kuti usina kururama, kana kuti uchiramba uchinetseka, nyaya idzi dzinofanira kukurukurwa nenyanzvi ine unyanzvi, iyo inogona kukutungamirira maererano nemamiriro ako ezvinhu.
MenstruationPurity.43: Zviratidzo izvi zviyeuchidzo zvedzidzo zvakajairika.Mugariro mumwe nomumwe unogona kuva nezvakajeka zvawo: kana paine kusava nechokwadi, kukurukurirana nenyanzvi ine unyanzvi kunoramba kuri chinhu chakanakisisa chokupindura chinokodzera mamiriro ako ezvinhu.

MiscarriageFertility.6: Unofanira kufunga kuti unofanira kuedza riini uye sei, uchizviita nenzira yako uye uine chivimbo.
MiscarriageFertility.13: Kubereka kunowanzodzoka pakutanga kwechikamu chenguva pashure pokubvisa pamuviri.
MiscarriageFertility.15: Zvichienderana nechirongwa chokurasikirwa, nguva yokudzoka panyama inogona kusiyana zvishoma kubva pane imwe mamiriro ezvinhu kuenda pane mamwe.
MiscarriageFertility.16: Nyanzvi dzakawanda dzinofunga kuti hapana chikonzero chokumirira kuti uwanezve chirwere ichi, kunze kwekunge chiremba wako kana kuti mubereki wako wevana akukurudzira zvakasiyana.
MiscarriageFertility.18: Kubereka kunowanzodzoka nokukurumidza, kutanga kwechikamu chinotevera.
MiscarriageFertility.20: Chikwata chechiremba chinogona kukurudzira kuti munhu apore zvishoma.
MiscarriageFertility.21: Kunzwa wakagadzirira, mumuviri uye mupfungwa, kunoramba kuri mutungamiriri unokosha  ⁇  kupfuura chero nguva ipi zvayo yenguva.
MiscarriageFertility.23: Kunzwa wakagadzirira mukati mako kunokosha zvikuru sokudzoka mumuviri.
MiscarriageFertility.25: Kutenderera nguva dzose uye kunzwa zvakanaka zviratidzo zvakanaka.
MiscarriageFertility.26: Semurume nomudzimai kana kuti pamwe chete
MiscarriageFertility.27: Kukurukura nezvazvo nomumwe wako kunogona kukubatsira kuti ufambire mberi.
MiscarriageFertility.28: Usati waedzazve, kusangana nachiremba kunogona kukubatsira kufambira mberi uine rugare rwepfungwa:
MiscarriageFertility.30: Kukurukura nenyanzvi kunoita kuti ukwanise kudzokorora zvakaitika.
MiscarriageFertility.32: Zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu, miedzo yakawedzerwa inogona kupiwa.
MiscarriageFertility.36: Kubvisa pamuviri kwaunoita uri woga hakuratidzi kuti une dambudziko rokubereka.
MiscarriageFertility.37: Kubereka kunowanzodzoka pakutanga kwechikamu pashure pokubvisa pamuviri.
MiscarriageFertility.38: Nyanzvi dzakawanda dzinofunga kuti hapana chikonzero chokumirira kutenderera kwakawanda, kunze kwokunge zvataurwa neimwe nzira.
MiscarriageFertility.39: Kunzwa wakagadzirira, mumuviri uye mupfungwa, kunoramba kuri nhungamiro inokosha zvikuru.
MiscarriageFertility.40: Kuongororwa kwaunoitwa nachiremba kunogona kukubatsira uye kukuvimbisa usati waedzazve.
MiscarriageFertility.41: Nyaya ino haitsivi mazano emunhu oga, asi chiremba wako kana kuti mubereki wako anogara ari bhuku rinobatsira panyaya yako.
MiscarriageFertility.42: Kubereka uye kuedzazve mushure mekurasikirwa  ⁇  AWA

MiscarriageGrief.6: Hapana nzira yakarurama yokugadzirisa nayo izvi. Munhu wose anozviita nenzira yake, nokukurumidza kwake.
MiscarriageGrief.14: Kusuruvara, kutsamwa, kana kunzwa kusisina chinhu ndizvo zvinowanzoitika pakurasikirwa uku, pasinei nokuti uri mumatanho api.
MiscarriageGrief.16: Hapana nzira yakarurama kana kuti yakaipa yokupfuura nayo.
MiscarriageGrief.17: Unogona kunzwa chimwe kana zvimwe zvezvinhu izvi, dzimwe nguva zvose kamwe chete:
MiscarriageGrief.19: Kushungurudzika kunogona kuuya nekupfuura, dzimwe nguva zvisingatarisirwi.
MiscarriageGrief.21: Kuzviona, mamiriro ezvinhu, kana kunzwa kusaruramisira uye izvozvo hazvina basa.
MiscarriageGrief.23: Kunzwa kusisina chinhu kana kuti kuvhiringidzika pamusoro pezvachangobva kuitika.
MiscarriageGrief.24: Kuzvipa nguva, pasina kumanikidzwa kana kuenzanisa, rutivi runokosha rwokupora.
MiscarriageGrief.26: Pasina kumanikidzwa kana kuti nguva yakatarwa yokuita kuti unzwe zviri nani.
MiscarriageGrief.28: Kushungurudzika kwose kwakasiyana nokwevamwe; hapana nzira yakarurama yokugadzirisa nayo.
MiscarriageGrief.30: Kunyora kana kuti kutaura zvaunonzwa kunogona kukubatsira kuti usanyanya kuzvidya mwoyo.
MiscarriageGrief.31: Kutaura nomumwe munhu ari pedyo newe, boka rokutsigira, kana kuti nyanzvi kunogona kukubatsira kuti usanyanya kuremara.

MiscarriageGrief.44: Muzvirwere, chiremba, chiremba wepfungwa, kana kuti boka rinokutsigira rinogona kukuteerera uye kukutsigira, pasina kutonga.
